_comment: Copy to profile.json and fill in with your own data. profile.json is gitignored.

_locked.note: Frozen sections render verbatim: no scoring, no selection, no reordering, whatever the JD says. Only `projects` and `skills` vary per JD.

What changed because of it, with a number: 3-5s down to ~700ms.

taglines.systems: How you'd introduce the same project to a systems team
taglines.agentic: And to an AI team - same project, honest reframing
